title: Mixed Methods Workbench
north_star: Direction: join method engines' outputs where a real study needs more than one method, without taking the methods' logic away from their own repositories (docs/adr/0002_broad_north_star_versioned_thin_slices.md).
thesis: Methods stay in their own repositories; the workbench reads their exports, keeps claim limits, and joins them only where a study needs it.
disproof: A real study that needs two producers' exports joined cannot be answered from what the producers export without re-running method logic inside the workbench.
not_for: Running a method itself, a universal schema or method planner, or publishing an unreviewed causal conclusion.
